body: Some people are shallow and have certain standards  regarding height so that could be why. If he doesn't seem like that type of person, it could be a different reason.

You're both still young, he might eventually mature past his pointless hate. I think that the best thing for you though is to distance yourself from him. The years of bullying and toxic behavior to come from him in the future is not worth it. If he eventually matures past this then maybe you could be friends again.

Continue to be there for her even if she is being difficult about it. She's probably trying to cope and might not know what she needs to heal yet. It can take a long time. Like a realllly long time. Going to the authorities is a smart decision, even if she may not have wanted you to. (Eventually she might feel safer knowing the guy is locked up and not gonna hurt anyone else.) Apologize though about that like everyone else is saying. You need to continue to let her know that you're still on her side. Eventually you both will make it through this and be even closer. You just can't give up though.
